description: Fließgewässermessstelle Bruecke uh. Flugplatz, Klötzlmühlbach is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by open.bydata. Die Messstelle Bruecke uh. Flugplatz (Messstellen-Nr: 105424) befindet sich im Gewässer Klötzlmühlbach in Bayern. Die Messstelle dient der Überwachung des biologischen Zustands, des chemischen Zustands. Coverage: open.bydata. The portal files it under the publisher open.bydata. Its tags are amphibien, bayern, biochemischer-sauerstoffbedarf, biologie, chemie. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
